slides.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: finished landscape 16:9 classroom infographic slide, Traditional Chinese Taiwan Mandarin.
Primary request: Explain the project's actual BM25 retrieval augmented generation replay using a clear three-panel educational infographic.
Style: white background, crisp dark navy outlines, large bold Traditional Chinese typography, mint and sky blue panels, amber selected evidence, rounded frames, spacious layout, matching a clean illustrated teaching deck. No people, robots, mascots or logos.
Title verbatim:「一題走完 R → A → G」
Subtitle verbatim:「怎麼申請長照服務？可以打 1966 嗎？」
Three large connected panels left to right.
Left heading「R 檢索」. Show a stack marked「24 個片段」feeding a magnifier and ranked selected cards under「BM25・取前 3 段」. Exact card text:「[L1-6]  7.92」「[L1-2]  7.66」「[L1-1]  4.77」. Show all three selected in amber, with horizontal score bars descending slightly then clearly shorter third bar. These are ranking scores, not keyword counts or probabilities. Do not add percent signs.
Middle heading「A 組提示」. Three visibly layered document sheets labeled「指示：依資料回答」「問題：申請長照與 1966」「片段：[L1-6] [L1-2] [L1-1]」. All three selected IDs flow here from left.
Right heading「G 附來源」. A concise answer card「可撥打長照專線 1966 [L1-2]」. A source document below labeled「原文 [L1-2]」connected to the answer's citation with a visible arrow and magnifier for checking.
Bottom takeaway verbatim「先檢索，再讓語言模型依片段回答」
Small lower note「沒有依據，就說資料不足」
Constraints: readable verbatim Traditional Chinese and IDs, meaningful illustrations, minimal words, no fake buttons, no additional datasets, no keyword-count scoring. Keep all text and frames comfortably inside 5% canvas safe margins.

Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: finished landscape 16:9 classroom infographic slide, Traditional Chinese Taiwan Mandarin.
Primary request: Guide learners through the actual RAG replay interface, with meaningful illustrations, concise labels and three sequential panels.
Style: white background, crisp dark navy outlines and large bold Traditional Chinese typography, rounded mint green and sky blue panels, amber evidence highlights, matching a clean illustrated teaching deck. No people, robots, mascots, logos, decorative objects or watermarks.
Title verbatim「換你看：逐步重播 RAG」
Three spacious illustrated panels connected by arrows.
Panel 1 heading「1 選資料與問題」. Show ONLY TWO database cylinders labeled「台灣長照」「電子系課程」. Below them show a question card with a selection chevron labeled「展示問題」. Convey selecting a dataset followed by one fixed question. No editable input field, no AI policy dataset.
Panel 2 heading「2 逐步觀察」. Show a compact three-step process: magnifier on ranked highlighted document cards labeled「BM25 計分」, then sheets assembling question and evidence labeled「組成提示」, then answer card with a citation [L1-2] labeled「生成回答」. Use downward arrows inside this panel. Clearly communicate sequential replay, not live chat.
Panel 3 heading「3 核對原文」. Show an answer card with highlighted clickable citation「[L1-2]」, a clear arrow leads to a source document with the same label「[L1-2]」and a magnifier examining a gold paragraph. Short caption「點來源編號」.
Bottom takeaway verbatim「看片段、看提示、看答案，再查來源」
Small note verbatim「固定問題，逐步重播」
Constraints: large readable Traditional Chinese, minimal text, exactly two datasets, no request for arbitrary questions or freeform rephrasing, no extra buttons or fake UI, all content within comfortable safe margins.

validationNote: BM25 replay with actual scores and the two current datasets. Original assets preserved.
